harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «تشقى» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «تذكرة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The first one had to come with the lām because the agents differ: the agent of the sending down is Allah, glory be to Him, and the agent of {لِتَشْقَى} is the Messenger ﷺ; as for «تذكرةً», it fulfils the conditions for being accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «تنزيلا»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governing word, i.e.: نزلناه تنزيلا (We sent it down a sending down). The preposition phrase «ممَّن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تنزيلا»; it is composed of the preposition «مِنْ» and the relative «مَنْ».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «استوى» is the khabar (predicate) of «الرحمن». The prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition phrase «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and the clause «له ما في السماوات» is a second khabar (predicate) of «الرحمن» in the previous verse.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: His saying «وأَخفَى»: a noun conjoined to «السِّر», and it is an elative (afʿal tafḍīl).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause of divine transcendence (jumlat al-tanzīh) is the khabar (predicate). «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar; the clause «له الأسماء» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «إذْ»: an adverbial noun, badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of {حَدِيثُ}. The clause «لَعَلِّي آتيكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; the clause «أوْ أَجِدُ» is conjoined to the single word «آتيكم».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «نُودِيَ» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun referring to the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «أنَا» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the yāʾ in «إِنِّي», and «ربُّك» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». The clause «فاخلع» is resumptive. «طوى»: a badal (substitute) of «الوادي».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «وأنا اختَرْتُك» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ}. The clause «فاستمِع» is conjoined to the clause «اخترتك».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «أنَا» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the yāʾ; the name of Majesty is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause of divine transcendence (jumlat al-tanzīh) is a second khabar of «إنَّ». As for «إلا أَنَّا»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «أنا» is a badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause «فاعبدني» is conjoined to the clause «إنني أنا الله».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «أكاد» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ», and the genitive interpreted maṣdar «لِتُجْزَى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أُخفيها». The bāʾ in «بما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun) [Translator's note: so in the source; it is «ما» that is maṣdariyya, the bāʾ being the preposition], and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to «تجزى».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: His saying «فلا يَصُدَّنك»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa in the position of the jussive; the nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «مَن» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). His saying «فَتَرْدَى»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أنْ»; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no turning away, and then a perishing.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His saying «وما تلك»: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «تلك» is an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; «تلك» is a demonstrative]; the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the demonstrative, and the clause «يا موسى» is resumptive within the context of the question.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «أتَوَكَّأُ» is a second khabar (predicate); the clause «ولي فيها مآربُ» is conjoined to the clause «أهشُّ», and the preposition phrase «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «يا موسى» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «فألقاها» is resumptive, and the clause «فإذا هي حيَّة» is conjoined to the clause «ألقاها»; «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «تسعَى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حية».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «سَنُعِيدُها» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and His saying «سِيرَتَها» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The verb «تخرج» is jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition. «بيضاء»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تخرج». The preposition phrase «من غير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second ḥāl of the agent of «تخرج». «آية»: the second object of an omitted verb, its implied form being: جعلناها آية (We made it a sign), and the implied clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The interpreted maṣdar «لِنُرِيَك» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلناها» implied in the previous verse; the preposition phrase «مِن آياتنا» is attached to an adjective of the second object implied in «لنريك», i.e.: لنريك شيئًا من آياتنا (that We may show you something of Our signs).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «إنَّهُ طَغَى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فرعون».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The preposition phrase «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشرح».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The preposition phrase «من لساني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عقدة».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «يَفْقَهُوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition phrase «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اجْعَل»; the preposition phrase «منْ أَهْلي» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «وَزِيرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «هَارُونَ» is a badal (substitute) of {وَزِيرًا}, and «أخي» is a badal of «هارون».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «كثيرًا»: a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: تسبيحًا كثيرًا (much glorifying). His saying «كَيْ نُسَبِّحَك»: kay is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The preposition phrase «بنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «سُؤْلَكَ»: the second object; the tāʾ, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in «أوتيت», is the first. The clause «يا مُوسَى» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The wāw in «ولقد» is a conjunction; the oath clause with its response is conjoined to the preceding clause {أُوتِيتَ}, and the clause «لقد مننَّا عليك» is the response to the oath; «مرة» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «إذْ» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {مَنَنَّا}; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «أن»: explicative (tafsīriyya) of the revelation in the previous verse, and the clause after it is explicative. The clause «يأخذه» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition; the preposition phrase «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عَدُوٌّ». The clause «ألقيت» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «مني» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «مَحَبَّةً». His saying «لِتُصْنَعَ»: the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is causal (taʿlīl); the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to an implied verb, its implied form being: ولتصنع فعلتُ ذلك (and that you might be brought up, I did that); the implied clause «فعلتُ» is conjoined to the clause «ألقيتُ».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «إذْ»: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {وَأَلْقَيْتُ}. The clause «فَرَجَعْنَاكَ» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «كَيْ تَقَرَّ» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām. The clause «فلبثتَ» is resumptive. «سنين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural, attached to the verb, and likewise the preposition phrase «في أهل». «مدين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with fatḥa because it is a diptote, being a proper name and feminine. The preposition phrase «على قدر» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «جئت», and the clause «يا موسى» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «واصطنعتُك» is conjoined to the clause (وَجِئْتَ).

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) agent. His saying «وأخوك»: a noun conjoined to the latent agent in «اذْهَبْ». The preposition phrase «بآياتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أخُوك» and what is conjoined to it.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «إنه طغَى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فرعون».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «ربَّنا»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, and the pronoun «نَا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The maṣdar «أن يفرط» is the object of «نَخافُ»; the clause «يَطغى» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the maṣdar is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «إنني معكما» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «أسمع» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «فَأَرْسِلْ» is conjoined to the clause «إنَّا رسُولا», and the clause «قد جئناك» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, as is the clause «والسلام على من اتبع». The preposition phrase «مِن ربِّك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن العذاب ...» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «أُوْحِيَ».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The fāʾ in «فمن» links to an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: إن أوحي إليكما فمَنْ ربكما؟ (if revelation has come to you, then who is your Lord?). The clause «فَمَنْ رَّبُّكُما» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; the clause {إنَّا قَدْ أُوحِيَ ...} is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb), and the clause «يا موسى» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «الذي» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «رَبُّنا»; «خَلْقَهُ» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: His saying «فما بالُ»: the fāʾ links to the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: إن كان ربُّكم كذلك فما بال؟ (if your Lord is thus, then what is the state…?). This clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «بال» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The preposition phrase «في كتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being established" (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached, and the clause «لا يَضِلُّ» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «الذي»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو الذي. The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition phrase «مِن نباتٍ» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أزواجًا»; «شَتَّى» is a second naʿt, i.e.: scattered, differing in colours and taste.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «كُلُوا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb of saying, and that saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أخرجنا», i.e.: so We brought forth such-and-such, saying: eat. The preposition phrase «لأوْلي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «خلقناكم» is resumptive. «تارَةً» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We will bring you forth another bringing forth.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «يا موسى» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The clause «نأتينك» is the response to an implied (muqaddar) oath, and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). The clause «فاجعلْ» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن قبلت فاجعل (if you accept, then set). «بيننا»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The clause «لا نُخْلِفُهُ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مَوْعِدًا». «نَحْنُ» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) agent, and the pronoun «أنت» is conjoined to the latent pronoun in «نُخْلفه». «مكانًا» is a badal (substitute) of «موعدًا», and «سُوًى» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «يَوْمُ» is the khabar (predicate), and the maṣdar «أَنْ يُحْشَرَ» is conjoined to «يومُ».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: His saying «وَيْلَكُمْ»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an unused (muhmal) verb, and the clause «لا تفتَروا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. His saying «فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أن» after the causative fāʾ; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no fabrication, and then an extirpation. The clause «وقد خاب» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «إنْ» is lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala), with a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa). The clause «يُرِيدان» is a naʿt (adjective); the maṣdar «أَن يُخْرِجَاكُمْ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «المثلى» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «صَفًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw, and the clause «وقد أَفلحَ» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: «إِمَّا» is a particle of choice (takhyīr), and the maṣdar «أن تلقي» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: choose either your throwing or our being the first. The maṣdar «أن نكون» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar. The relative noun «مَنْ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «بل أَلْقُوا» is resumptive, and the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: I will not throw first. His saying «فإذا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause after it is conjoined to the implied clause «فَأَلْقَوْا», the implied form being: "He said: I will not throw first; rather, you throw. So they threw, and behold…". The maqūl al-qawl is implied, and the implied clause «فألقَوْا» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أنَّهَا تَسْعَى» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «فأَوْجَسَ» is resumptive. «خِيفَةً» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مُوسَى» is the fāʿil (agent) placed later.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «أنْتَ» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك», and «الأعلى» is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause «إنك أنت الأعلى» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «وأَلْقِ» is conjoined to the clause {لا تَخَفْ}, and the clause «تَلْقَفْ» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition. «إنَّ» is an abrogating particle (nāsikha); «ما» is a relative noun, its noun; «كَيْدُ» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; and the clause «ولا يُفْلِحُ» is conjoined to the resumptive one: «إنَِّمَا صَنَعُوا كيدُ».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «فَأُلْقِي» is resumptive; «سُجَّدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the sorcerers, and the clause «قالوا» is a second ḥāl of «السحرة».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أَنْ آذَنَ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «أَنْ» is a maṣdar-forming particle. The clause «إنه لكبيرُكم» is resumptive; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «فلأقطعَن أيديَكم» is resumptive, and the clause «لأقطعن» is the response to an implied (muqaddar) oath. His saying «ولَتَعْلَمُنَّ»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and the verb is an imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis (tawkīd). «أَيُّنَا»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; «أَشَدُّ» is the khabar (predicate); «عذابا» is tamyīz (specification); «وأبقى» is a noun conjoined to «أشدّ». The clause «أيُّنَا أشد» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of knowing, which is suspended (muʿallaq).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: His saying «والذي»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to the preceding «ما». His saying «فاقْضِ»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter. The clause «أنتَ قاضٍ» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause «أنتَ قاضٍ» is the ṣila of the relative noun [Translator's note: this sentence is repeated in the source]. «هذه» is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الحياةَ الدُّنيا»: a badal (substitute) and its naʿt (adjective). The clause «إنما تَقضِي» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: His saying «وما»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «خَطايانا»; the preposition phrase «من السحر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «عليه», and the clause «والله خيْرٌ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ». «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «مُجْرِمًا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يأتِ»; the clause «لا يموت» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «له».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «قد عمِل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مؤمنًا», and «مؤمنًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «يَأتِهِ». The clause «فأولئك لهم..» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause «لهم الدرجات» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «جناتٌ» is a badal (substitute) of {الدَّرَجَاتُ}; the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جناتُ»; the clause «وذلك جزاء» is resumptive; «مَن» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative. The clause «فاضْرِبْ» is conjoined to the clause «أَسْرِ»; the preposition phrase «في البحر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طريقًا»; «يَبَسًا» is a second naʿt; the clause «لا تخاف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of «اضربْ», i.e.: strike, not fearing.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «فأَتْبَعَهُمْ» is resumptive, and the clause «فغشيهم» is conjoined to the clause «أتبعَهم»; «ما» is a relative noun, fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «وأَضَلَّ» is conjoined to the clause {فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The clause «قد أنجيناكم» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; «جانب» is the second object of the appointing (muwāʿada), and «الأيمن» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جانب».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «كُلُوا» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من طيبات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). His saying «فَيَحِلَّ»: the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no transgression, and then a descending of My wrath. The clause «ومَن يَحْلِلْ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «وإني لَغَفَّارٌ» is resumptive, and the preposition phrase «لمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غفَّار».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «وما أَعْجَلَكَ»: the wāw is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «أَعْجَلك» is the khabar (predicate); the clause «يا موسى» is resumptive within the context of the question.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «هُمْ أُولاءِ»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أُولاءِ» is a demonstrative, the object of an omitted verb, i.e.: أعني هؤلاء (I mean these). The preposition phrase «على أثَرِي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «أعني أولاء» is parenthetical, and the clause «رَبِّ» is parenthetical; the maṣdar «لترضى» is genitive, attached to «عَجِلْتُ».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: do not wait for your people, for We…; the clause «فإنَّا قَد فَتَنَّا» is conjoined to the implied object of the speech, and the clause «وأضَلَّهم السَّامري» is conjoined to the clause «فتنَّا».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «غضبانَ أسفًا»: two ḥāls (circumstantials) of Moses. «يَا قَوْمِ»: the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the dropped yāʾ. The clause «فطال» is conjoined to the clause «ألم يَعِدْكم»; the clause «أَرَدتم» is conjoined to the clause «طال»; and the clause «فأخلفتم» is conjoined to the clause «أردتم».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The preposition phrase «بمَلْكِنَا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخلف», and the clause «ولكنَّا حُمِّلْنَا» is conjoined to «ما أخلفنا». The preposition phrase «مِن زِينة» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أَوْزَارًا»; the clause «فقذفناها» is conjoined to the clause «حُمِّلنا»; the clause «أَلْقَى» is resumptive. His saying «فكذلك»: the fāʾ is resumptive, the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied form is: أَلْقَى السامري إلقاءً مثلَ ذلك الإلقاء (the Sāmirī threw a throwing like that throwing).

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «فأخرجَ» is conjoined to the clause {أَلْقَى}; «جسدا» is a naʿt (adjective), and the clause «لَهُ خُوَارٌ» is a second naʿt; the clause «فَنَسِي» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb).

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «أَفَلا يَرَوْنَ» is resumptive. «أن» is lightened from the heavy one (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لا يَرْجِعُ» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «يرون». The preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ضَرًّا».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «ولقد قال لهم هارونُ» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد قال» is the response to the oath. The clause «إنَّمَا فُتِنْتُم» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «وإنَّ ربَّكم الرحمنُ» is conjoined to the clause «إنما فتنتم», and the clause «فاتَّبِعُونِي» is conjoined to the clause «إن ربكم الرحمن».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: «نبرحَ» is an abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb, accusative; «عاكفين» is the khabar (predicate) of «نبرح»; and the interpreted maṣdar (حتى أن يرجع) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عاكفين».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «منَعَك» is the khabar (predicate). «إذْ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منع»; the clause «رأيتَهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «ضَلُّوا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: «ألا»: an «أنْ» that puts the verb in the accusative, and a redundant (zāʾida) lā; the maṣdar is the second object of «منع», i.e.: what prevented you from following me? «منع» is transitive by itself and with «مِن», as in: منعتُه النومَ and منعتُه مِن النوم (I prevented him from sleep). The clause «تتبعن» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, and the clause «أفعصَيت» is conjoined to the clause «تتبعن».

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: «يا ابْنَ أُمَّ»: yā is the vocative particle; «ابن» is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; «أُمَّ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was changed into an alif and then dropped for lightness. The clause «إني خشِيت» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the maṣdar «أن تقُول» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) is implied (muqaddar), i.e.: he said: this is my brother's speech. The clause «فما خَطْبُك» is conjoined to the object of the speech; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «وخطبُك» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The preposition phrase «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بَصُرْتُ»; the preposition phrase «مِن أثر» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «قبضة». His saying «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: سوَّلتْ لي تسويلا مثلَ ذلك التسويل (it enticed me an enticing like that enticing); the clause «سوَّلتْ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The clause «فاذهبْ» is the apodosis of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: إن تكفر فاذهب (if you disbelieve, then go), and the clause «فإن لك..» is conjoined to the clause «اذهب». The maṣdar «أنْ تقُول» is the noun of inna; the preposition phrase «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «في الحياة» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf. «لا» is the lā of generic negation, with its noun, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing). The clause «لن تُخْلفَه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «موعدًا»; «عاكفًا» is the khabar of ẓalla; the clause «لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ» is the response to the oath, and the oath with its response is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «إنَّمَا»: a restraining particle (kāffa) and the restrained one (makfūfa), with a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «إلهُكم», and the clause of divine transcendence (jumlat al-tanzīh) is the ṣila (relative clause); «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «هو» is a badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The clause «وَسِعَ» is resumptive, and «علمًا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: (كذلك نقص عليك) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ذلك» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: نَقُصُّ عليك قصصًا مثل ذلك القصص (We relate to you a relating like that relating). The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «نقصُّ» is resumptive; «ذكرًا»: the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the conditional clause is a naʿt (adjective) of {ذِكْرًا}, and the clause «فإنه يحمل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of the jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of {يَحْمِلُ}; it came in the plural form in consideration of the meaning of the preceding «مَن», having first been construed according to its wording, so the pronoun was made singular. The prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». His saying «وَسَاء»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ساء» is a past verb whose fāʿil is the pronoun huwa, i.e.: وساء الحمل (and evil is the burden). The preposition phrase «لَهُم» is attached to a ḥāl of «حملا»; «حملا» is tamyīz (specification), explaining the pronoun of «ساء». The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being: وِزْرُهُم (their burden), i.e.: وساء الحِمل حِملا وِزْرُهُم (and evil as a burden is their burden). The clause «وساء» is conjoined to the single word «خالدين».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: «يَوم» is a badal (substitute) of {يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ}; the preposition phrase «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يُنفَخ»; «زُرْقًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المجرمين»; and the tanwīn in «يَوْمَئِذٍ» is a compensation for a clause.

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: The clause «يَتخافتُون» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) of {الْمُجْرِمِينَ}. «إنْ» is negating; «عَشْرًا» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لَبِثتُم». The clause «إنْ لبثتم» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) of an omitted verb of saying which is a ḥāl of the wāw, the implied form being: قائلين (saying). The tāʾ was omitted from «عَشرًا» because what it specifies is the nights.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «نحنُ أَعلمُ» is resumptive. The bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم». «إذْ» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «أعلم»; «طَرِيقةً» is tamyīz (specification); «إنْ» is negating; «يومًا» is an adverb attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «فَقُلْ» is conjoined to the clause «ويسألونك».

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The clause «فَيَذَرُهَا» is conjoined to the clause {يَنْسِفُهَا}; «قاعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun hāʾ; «صَفْصَفًا»: a second ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The clause «لا تَرَى» is a third ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in {فَيَذَرُهَا}.

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The clause «يتَّبعون» is resumptive; the clause «لا عِوَجَ له» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الداعي»; the clause «وخشَعتِ الأصوات» is conjoined to the clause «يتبعون»; and the clause «فلا تَسمعُ» is conjoined to the clause «خشَعت».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: «يومَئذ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تنفع»; the clause «لا تنفعُ» is resumptive; «مَن» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «يَعلمُ» is resumptive, and the clause «ولا يحيطون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «خلفهم». «علمًا» is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): a maṣdar (verbal noun) synonymous with the word governing it.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The clause «وعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ» is resumptive, and so is the clause «وقد خاب».

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The clause «ومَن يعملْ» is resumptive; the clause «وهو مؤمن» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعملْ». The clause «فلا يخاف» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: فهو لا يخاف (then he does not fear), and the clause «فهو لا يخاف» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فلا يخاف» cannot be the apodosis, because an imperfect verb joined with «لا» does not take the fāʾ. The preposition phrase «مِن الصالحات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: شيئًا كائنًا من الصالحات (something that is of the righteous deeds).

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: His saying «وكذلك»: the wāw is a conjunction, the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: أنزلناه إنزالا مثلَ ذلك الإنزالِ (We sent it down a sending down like that sending down). The clause «أنزلناه» is resumptive. His saying «قرآنًا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial); the ḥāl may be a non-derived (jāmid) noun here because it is qualified. The clause «لعلهم يتقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The clause «فَتَعَالَى الله» is conjoined to the clause {أَنْزَلْنَاهُ}; «الملك الحق» are two naʿts (adjectives) of the name of Majesty. The clause «رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْما» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb), and «علمًا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: The preposition phrase «لَهُ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «وَلَمْ نَجِدْ» is conjoined to the clause «نَسي».

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: «وَإِذْ»: the wāw is resumptive, and «إذ» is the object of an implied (muqaddar) «اذْكُرْ» (remember); the clause «أَبَى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: The clause «فَقُلْنَا» is resumptive. His saying «وَلِزَوْجِكَ»: conjoined to the kāf in «لك», attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to. The clause «فلا يخرجنَّكما» is conjoined to the clause «إن هذا عدو». The fāʾ in «فتشقى» is causative (sababiyya); His saying «فَتَشْقَى»: an imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be no expelling of you both from it, and then misery for you.

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ألا تجوع» is the noun of inna, and the preposition phrase «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The maṣdar «وأنك لا تظمأ» is conjoined to the preceding maṣdar, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: The clause «فَوَسْوَسَ» is resumptive; the clause «قال» is explicative of the whispering; the clause «لا يَبْلى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مُلْكٍ».

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The preposition phrase «عليهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) «أعني» (I mean); the clause «يخصفان» is the khabar (predicate) of «طفق»; and the clause «وعَصَى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The clause «اجْتَبَاهُ» is conjoined to the clause {وَعَصَى}.

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اهبطا»; the prepositional phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عَدُو»; and the clause «بعضكم لبعض عدو» is a second ḥāl of the agent of «اهْبِطَا». The clause «فإما يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مني هُدًى» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). The clause «مَن اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ» is the apodosis of the first condition; the clause «لا يَضِلُّ» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو, and the clause «فهو لا يضل» is the apodosis of the second condition.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: The clause «ونَحْشُرُهُ» is resumptive, and His saying «أعمى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «نحشره».

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive; its alif was dropped for lightness because it is preceded by the preposition. «أعمى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the yāʾ, and the clause «وقد كنت بصيرا» is a second ḥāl of the yāʾ in «حشرتني».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: His saying «كذلك»: the kāf is a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: أتتك إتيانًا مثل ذلك الإتيان (they came to you a coming like that coming). The clause «أتتك» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb), and the clause «تُنْسَى» is conjoined to the clause «نسيتُها».

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «نَجْزِي» is conjoined to the clause {تُنْسَى}; the clause «ولَعَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ» is resumptive, and the lām is for emphasis (taʾkīd).

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The fāʿil (agent) of «يَهْدِ» is implied (muqaddar), indicated by the verb, i.e.: guidance. «كم» is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition phrase «مِنَ الْقُرُونِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «كم»; the clause «يمشون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «لهم». The clause «أَهْلَكْنَا» is the mafʿūl bihi of «يَهْدِ», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by «كم», containing the meaning of knowing. The preposition phrase «لأولِي» is attached to a naʿt of «لآيَاتٍ».

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: The clause «ولَوْلا كَلِمَةٌ» is resumptive. «لولا» is a particle of impossibility because of existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «كلمة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing). «لِزَامًا» is the khabar of kāna, and its noun is the pronoun of the destruction. His saying «وأَجَلٌ»: conjoined to «كلمة».

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: The clause «فَاصْبِرْ» is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اصبِرْ». The preposition phrase «بِحَمْدِ» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «سَبِّحْ». His saying «ومِن آنَاءِ الَّليْلِ»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the prepositional phrase is attached to «سَبِّحْ»; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). «أَطْرَافَ»: a noun conjoined to the position of «مِنْ آناء» and attached to what that is attached to. The clause «لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: «أزواجًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «زَهْرَةَ» is a badal (substitute) of «أزواجًا», on the supposition that they were made the very splendour itself. The genitive interpreted maṣdar «لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مَتَّعْنَا», and the clause «ورِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:132-132.t: The clause «لا نَسْأَلُكَ» is resumptive, and so is the clause «نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ», and the clause «وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَى».

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the preposition phrase «مِن ربِّهِ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آية». The clause «لَوْلا يَأْتِينَا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb); the clause «أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: His saying «وَلَوْ أَنَّا»: the wāw is resumptive; «لو» is a particle of impossibility because of impossibility (imtināʿ li-imtināʿ), and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied (muqaddar) «ثبت»; the clause «ولو ثبت أنَّا» is resumptive. The preposition phrase «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب». «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the fāʾ is causative (sababiyya), and «نَتَّبِعَ» is an imperfect verb in the accusative by a concealed «أن» after the causative fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted (mutaṣayyad) from the preceding speech, i.e.: would that there were a sending from You, and then a following from us.

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The tanwīn in «كُلٌّ» is a compensation for a single word, i.e.: كل أحد (every one). The clause «فَتَرَبَّصُوا» is conjoined to the clause «كُلٌّ مُتَرَبِّصٌ»; the clause «فستعلمون» is resumptive; the clause «مَنْ أصْحَابُ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of knowing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أصحاب» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «مَنِ اهْتَدَى» is conjoined to the clause «مَنْ أصْحَابُ».
